slides.headline: Saudi [[under fire.]] Cairo backs.
bullets: **Najran:** coalition helicopter crashes, 2 crew dead; Houthis claim a shoot-down (Reuters).
**Egypt:** Sisi says it is ready to defend Saudi Arabia "if requested" (Oct 17).
**Riyadh:** air-threat alert; a skyscraper tells tenants to work from home (AFP).
slides.sources: Sources: Reuters, AFP via Times of Israel; CBS live blog (Oct 16-18). Coalition and Houthi statements are claims.

slides.headline: Tug hit. [[Threats fly.]]
bullets: **Khor Fakkan:** two projectiles hit a tug off the UAE; one minor injury, UKMTO says.
**Hormuz:** Araghchi, in Baghdad, says Iran's 7-day reopening plan "remains on the table".
**Threats:** Trump says the US could "soon finish the job"; Araghchi: "Want to try your luck again?"
slides.sources: Sources: Fox/CBS live blogs citing UKMTO, Truth Social, X (Oct 18). Statements by Trump, Iran and CENTCOM are claims.

slides.headline: Sanctions [[waived.]] Strikes go on.
bullets: **Sanctions:** Trump waives parts of Russia penalties, review up to 60 days; Zelenskyy warns it emboldens Putin.
**Kyiv:** Zelenskyy says the war "must be brought to an end"; Trump says he doesn't want that.
**Strikes:** Russian attacks kill 2 in Volyn and a woman in Zaporizhzhia, Ukrainian officials say.
slides.sources: Sources: Al Jazeera (Oct 18), Reuters via Fox. Casualty figures are from Ukrainian officials; statements by Trump and Zelenskyy are claims.

slides.headline: Settlers [[spark]] US alarm.
bullets: **Taybeh:** Rubio says he is "very disturbed" by the attack on diplomats; urges a crackdown (Reuters).
**Abu Falah:** WaPo photographer Heidi Levine beaten Friday; her son says 4 vertebrae broke.
**Al-Maghazi:** Hamas-linked media say troops shot dead a girl, 7; the IDF has not commented.
slides.sources: Sources: Times of Israel liveblog (Oct 18), Reuters. Hamas-linked media reports are unverified.

slides.headline: Today in [[4 numbers]]

stats.l: Ships transiting Hormuz not hit, CENTCOM claims
Brent crude settled Friday, highest since May 19
Houthi attacks on Riyadh airport in Oct, coalition says
Settler attacks on Palestinians since Sep 27, Yesh Din

slides.sources: Sources: CBS, Fox/Reuters, Yesh Din. CENTCOM and coalition figures are party claims and unverified.

slides.headline: Next [[24 hours]]
bullets: **Egypt:** parliament debates backing Saudi Arabia on Monday.
**Tehran:** Lavrov due Monday; will Trump "finish the job"?
**Hormuz:** does Iran block "illegal routes" near Oman's coast?
**West Bank:** Oct 27 vote; will Israel act on settler violence?

caption_instagram:
4 fronts. 24 hours. Here's what changed. ⬇️

🇾🇪 YEMEN / SAUDI ARABIA — A Saudi-led coalition helicopter crashed in Najran, killing 2 crew; the coalition blames a technical fault, the Houthis claim a shoot-down (Reuters). Egypt's Sisi says Egypt is ready to defend Saudi Arabia "if requested" (CBS, Oct 17).

🇮🇷 IRAN WAR (Day 233) — A tug was hit by two projectiles off Khor Fakkan, UAE; one minor injury (UKMTO). Araghchi says Iran's 7-day Hormuz plan "remains on the table"; Trump says the US could "soon finish the job." CENTCOM claims ~97% of ships pass unhit (Fox/CBS).

🇺🇦 UKRAINE (Day 1,698) — Trump waived parts of Russia sanctions with a review of up to 60 days; Zelenskyy warns it could embolden Putin. Russian strikes killed 2 in Volyn and a woman in Zaporizhzhia, Ukrainian officials say (Al Jazeera).

🇵🇸 GAZA / WEST BANK — Rubio says he is "very disturbed" by settler violence after the Taybeh attack on diplomats (Reuters). Yesh Din counts 170+ settler attacks since Sep 27.

Sources: Al Jazeera, Reuters, CBS, Fox, Times of Israel, UKMTO. Warring-party claims are unverified.
